growth.source: Tracxn legal-entity financial profile (sourced from India MCA/ROC filings) -- Vini Cosmetics Pvt Ltd, maker of Fogg deodorants
growth.notes: SCOPE CAVEAT: company-level (Vini Cosmetics Pvt Ltd, maker of Fogg -- Indias largest deodorant brand by volume share, ~15-16%), not a category-wide India deodorants market figure; used as proxy since Vini Cosmetics is a deodorant-focused company, unlike HUL/Godrej/ITC where deo is one line among many and no brand-level figure could be found in any fetchable source despite repeated attempts. Direct quote from source: VINI COSMETICS PRIVATE LIMITED generated more than INR 1,000 Cr in revenue for the financial year ending on Mar 31, 2025. The revenue has a compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 17% in the last 1 year. Tracxns 1-year CAGR is mathematically a single-year YoY growth rate (CAGR over exactly one year reduces to simple YoY), so this is not a CAGR-to-YoY substitution. Underlying data sourced by Tracxn from India MCA/ROC company filings; exact FY24 comparator and units not shown in free view. Corroborating datapoint, not a separate claim: McNroe Consumer Products (Wild Stone, #2 deodorant maker) shows a similar 1-year CAGR of 20% for FY25 on the same Tracxn platform -- consistent directionally, do not average. Organised-market only; no unorganised-market read implied.

shares.qualifier: Shares of summed revenue for 3 listed BRAND OWNERS (INR inr_cr, NET_REALISATION). Does NOT include unorganised/unlisted players. Conglomerate members (HUL/Godrej/LG H&H) carry non-BPC revenue, so their shares overstate BPC position. Excluded as different value-chain levels (not brand shares): Nykaa (FSN E-Commerce) (retailer).

bottom_up.qualifier: Sum of latest reported revenue for 3 listed players (INR inr_cr), NET_REALISATION basis. Coverage excludes unorganised/unlisted competitors. NOT a market size: Godrej Consumer Products, Hindustan Unilever report revenue well beyond BPC (conglomerate/total-company figures). Excluded as different value-chain levels (not brand owners): Nykaa (FSN E-Commerce) (retailer).

mismatches: Unit/currency differ (top-down USD usd_bn vs bottom-up INR inr_cr) - convert before comparing.
Value basis differs (top-down RETAIL vs bottom-up NET_REALISATION). India RETAIL vs NET_REALISATION differ by the MRP trade margin (lib/transforms/mrp_normalise.py).
Bottom-up base is inflated by non-pure-play conglomerates (Godrej Consumer Products, Hindustan Unilever) reporting non-BPC revenue.
reconciliation.note: Numeric gap not computed: bases are not directly comparable (see mismatches). Bottom-up here is a coverage indicator, not a market-size cross-check.
